topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: you should first pay down the card that charges the highest rate. Pay as much as you can toward that debt each month until your balance is once again zero, while still paying the minimum on your other cards.
question: Misconception: If I owe balances on several credit cards, I should divide my extra payments equally among them.
answer: Instead, pay as much as you can toward the card with the highest interest rate while making at least the minimum payments on your other cards. After that balance is paid off, focus on the next-highest-rate balance.
